weapons.name: MP7 Submachine Gun
weapons.source_note: HK MP7A1 manual specification table: "Barrel length 180 mm" and "Twist length (righthand twist) 160 mm". States twist as 160 mm, right-hand, for the 4.6 x 30 calibre.

weapons.name: UMP-45 Submachine Gun
weapons.source_note: HK UMP manual specification table: "Caliber 45 ACP", "Barrel length 200 mm (7.87 in)", "Twist length 406 mm (15.98 in)", "Bore profile 6x polygonal, right-hand twist". 406 mm equals 1 turn in 16 inches.

weapons.name: LRP-07 .308 Winchester
weapons.source_note: JP Enterprises LRP-07 Designated Marksman Rifle page: "Barrel: .308 JP Supermatch barrel, 20\" medium contour, 1:10 twist, Thermo-Fit installation". 1 turn in 10 inches = 254 mm.

weapons.name: SCR-11 .223 Remington
weapons.source_note: JP Enterprises SCR-11 Order Form, barrel options: "14.5\" - Custom length .223, light contour, 1:8 twist, mid-length gas system". 1 turn in 8 inches = 203.2 mm. The document states 1:8 for the .223 barrel; JP lists all .223 Wylde/Supermatch barrels as 1:8.
